article.title: OpenAI試推ChatGPT商家中心，美國合資格商戶可設品牌代理
article.summary: 商家中心進入測試階段，合資格商戶可認領品牌資料。品牌代理先向合資格的美國電商及線上服務商戶開放。
highlights: 商戶通過驗證後可更新資料及提交含售價和庫存的產品資料。
匯總數據包括品牌提及及網站點擊，達到門檻才顯示。
article.why: 品牌可以把AI搜尋中的店家資料和顧客自助問答納入同一套營運流程。
article.next_step: 先核對商戶所在地及資格，再指定產品資料更新和客服答覆的負責人。
article.detail: OpenAI公布商家可在Business Hub認領品牌，通過驗證後管理資料及提交產品清單。符合門檻的商戶可看到提及和網站點擊等匯總數據。另一項功能Business Agents先開放給合資格的美國電商及線上服務商戶。顧客可從品牌檔案選擇開始對話，由品牌代理使用企業提供的資料回答產品或服務問題。
article.title_en: OpenAI launches a ChatGPT business hub beta and agents for eligible US businesses
article.summary_en: Eligible businesses can claim their profiles in the Business Hub beta. Business Agents are initially open to eligible US ecommerce and online service businesses.
highlights_en: Verified businesses can update their profile and submit product feeds with prices and availability.
Aggregate mentions and website clicks are visible when thresholds are met.
article.why_en: Brands can manage AI discovery profiles and customer self-service as part of the same workflow.
article.next_step_en: Confirm market and business eligibility, then assign owners for feed updates and support responses.
article.detail_en: OpenAI says eligible companies can claim a profile in Business Hub. Verified businesses can update details and submit a product feed. Businesses that meet data thresholds can see aggregate mentions and site clicks. Business Agents initially serve eligible US ecommerce and online service businesses. Shoppers can start a separate chat from a profile to ask the brand agent about its offerings.
